title: Jayden Daniels on clock debacle: "Ultimately, it's on me"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jayden Daniels on clock debacle: "Ultimately, it's on me"
sources.description: When it comes to the Week 5 overtime clock debacle for the Commanders, both coach Dan Quinn and quarterback Jayden Daniels continue to take the blame for the failure to stop the clock before a potential game-winning field.
